definition.activation_day: group rank <= 3 AND group average daily return >= 2% AND up ratio >= 60%
definition.leader_hit: stock appears in that group's top 3 daily returns on an activation day
definition.top1_hit: stock ranks #1 by daily return inside the group on an activation day
definition.note: close-to-close daily data only; this does not measure intraday first mover timing
definition.follow_through: after a stock is top 3 on an activation day, measure close-to-close return 1/3/5 market trading days later; missing future prices are excluded
